def wrap_subconflicts(key, subconflicts):
    unresolved_conflicts = []
    for conf in subconflicts:
        (path, ld, rd, strategy) = conf
        assert path[-1] == key
        path = path[:-1]
        ld = [op_patch(key, ld)]
        rd = [op_patch(key, rd)]
        unresolved_conflicts.append((path, ld, rd, strategy))
    return unresolved_conflicts
